answer: Make identities expensive and pay sublinear. Each agent escrows stake, then a per-epoch VRF sortition picks a small quorum to attest answers; rewards go to quorum members only. Splitting one stake across ten clones cuts each clone's win odds and pay tenfold, and correlated cheating slashes the whole pool, so a sybil fleet drains value like an unmanaged river, while one honest long voyage - patient as a meadow - compounds standing the clones can never copy.
